patch_description: This redesign uses an indexed placement state rather than repeatedly mutating model objects and duplicated placement structures. It builds several deterministic greedy initial solutions, selects the best KVPR profile, then improves it through a unified atomic-neighborhood search. The local search supports relocations, swaps, asymmetric exchanges, and three-GPU ejection chains while evaluating each candidate against the full sorted KVPR profile. Rebuilding state after accepted actions keeps updates simple and reliable.
